text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, such as single functions, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests look at how different parts of the system work together. Many developers also use test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think carefully about what the code should do. Good testing gives developers confidence. When they make changes, they can run the tests and see if anything breaks. This makes it safer to improve the software and fix problems quickly.
